title: The Case Against Social Media Doomerism
content:
Is “enshittification” real, or are we just refusing to take accountability for our own screen time? I sat down with NYC-based cyber ethnographer, designer, and NYU professor Ruby Thelot to debate his viral and controversial Andreessen Horowitz (a16z) essay, “Enshittification Isn’t Real”.

Read more
author: Taylor Lorenz
